canResume.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether you can resume the VM.

canStart.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether you can start the VM.

canStop.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether you can stop the VM.

consoleDevices.doc: The list of configured console devices on the VM.

delegate.doc: A custom object you use to determine when the VM stops.

directorySharingDevices.doc: The list of configured directory-sharing devices on the VM.

graphicsDevices.doc: The list of configured graphics devices on the virtual machine.

memoryBalloonDevices.doc: The array of devices that you use to adjust the amount of memory available to the guest system.

networkDevices.doc: The list of configured network devices on the VM.

pause(completionHandler:).doc: Pauses a running VM and notifies the specified completion handler of the results.

queue.doc: The queue associated with this virtual machine.

resume(completionHandler:).doc: Resumes a paused VM and notifies the specified completion handler of the results.

socketDevices.doc: The array of socket devices that the VM configures for use ports in the guest VM.

start(completionHandler:).doc: Starts the VM and notifies the specified completion handler if startup is successful.

state.doc: The current execution state of the VM.

supported.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the system supports virtualization.

usbControllers.doc: The list of runtime USB controller objects.

CPUCount.doc: The number of CPUs you make available to the guest operating system.

bootLoader.doc: The guest system to boot when the VM starts.

consoleDevices.doc: The array of console devices that you expose to the guest operating system.

customVirtioDevices.doc: The array of custom virtio devices that you expose to the guest operating system.

directorySharingDevices.doc: The list of directory sharing devices.

entropyDevices.doc: The array of randomization devices that you expose to the guest operating system.

label.doc: An optional label for the virtual machine.

maximumAllowedCPUCount.doc: The maximum number of CPUs you may configure for the VM.

maximumAllowedMemorySize.doc: The maximum amount of memory that you may configure for the VM.

memoryBalloonDevices.doc: An array that you configure with a memory balloon device, used to update the memory in the VM.

memorySize.doc: The amount of physical memory the guest operating system recognizes.

minimumAllowedCPUCount.doc: The minimum number of CPUs you may configure for the VM.

minimumAllowedMemorySize.doc: The minimum amount of memory that you may configure for the VM.

networkDevices.doc: The array of network devices that you expose to the guest operating system.

serialPorts.doc: The array of serial ports that you expose to the guest operating system.

socketDevices.doc: The socket device that you use to implement port-based communication with the guest operating system.

storageDevices.doc: The array of storage devices that you expose to the guest operating system.

usbControllers.doc: The list of configured USB controllers for the VM.

automaticallyReconfiguresDisplay.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the graphics display associated with this view automatically reconfigures with respect to view changes.

capturesSystemKeys.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the system should send certain system keyboard shortcuts to the guest instead of the host.

virtualMachine.doc: The VM to display in the view.

network.doc: The network object that the you initialize the attachment with.
